judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The point is plain and the Ogre threat sits right in Nox's world, but the clipped three-beat 'Sorry. Gate's barred. Turn around.' and the moody 'Nobody comes in through this gate anymore' read like a modern writer working on terse barks. Westwood's guards are wordier and more stilted. 'I would see ... first' also feels a little too careful.
